owner_request.quote: 都还可以  只能生成50张吗   搞10000张
owner_request.interpretation: Freeze the delivered v7 fifty as the accepted reference family, automatically mine and render 10,000 distinct strict examples, and create no manual review workload. This request does not authorize training, labels, holdout access or promotion.

official_archive.provider: OKX official historical market data monthly candlestick archives
official_archive.symbol_rule: Every non-empty, non-deep symbol already admitted by the hash-pinned candidate9000 source audit; unavailable monthly archives are recorded as 404 and not substituted.
official_archive.boundary_rule: Only complete UTC months whose end is no later than 2025-06-01 are requested. This is strictly before the repository holdout and no archive at/after 2026-05-04 is requested or read.

reference_family.method: Nearest of all 50 Owner-accepted v7 examples. Direction is normalized but time is never reversed.
reference_family.reason: The Owner explicitly accepted the delivered fifty as a family. Using all fifty adds accepted modes without relaxing the frozen morphology gate or distance threshold.
reference_family.direction_normalization: LONG sign +1; SHORT sign -1; time order is never reversed.

scan.nms_choice: minimum similarity distance within each fixed one-hour event cluster; a new cluster starts when its endpoint is at least one hour after the prior cluster's first endpoint
scan.future_visibility: Core+5 is used only to retrieve completed historical examples. It is not a causal signal or live detector.

selection.fail_closed: If either side cannot supply 5,000 after exact-core collapse, one-hour event NMS and diversity quotas, render nothing and do not relax a threshold.

render.box_vertical_source: Core high/low plus six MA values with 4% price-span padding.

controls.exact_duplicate_null: Event IDs, image hashes and core identities must each be unique across 10,000 outputs.
controls.direction_null: For selected rows, correct direction-normalized distance must beat the opposite-direction distance; report the count and sign-test p-value.
controls.render_parity: All images are generated by the same render_chart path at 1280x742 and must contain exact red rectangle pixels at the manifest geometry.
controls.economic_metrics: Not applicable: this P0 shape-example run defines no entry, exit, TP/SL, costs or model score.
